# Burning Love Challenge 2024

- Duchess Flame![Writer: Duchess Flame]()
- Jan 27, 2024
- 4 min read

Updated: Jul 29, 2024

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_e848f5de7f964694a4fa3d57d656a8af~mv2.png)

Image credit: __SugarBombs.RADS__

Dedicated to __WOTW__, Thank you for your love and support <3 

The Burning Love Challenge is the 2024 Valentine event in Fallout 76.

On the 30th of January at 12pm EST (Atom Shop changeover), you will be able to claim the Hot Rod Pink Flamer skin for free from the atom shop.

You will need to apply this skin to a flamer and complete a set number of challenges to unlock limited-time rewards.

__FAQ__

**Can the Hot Rod pink Flamer skin be applied to the Holy Fire?**

As of Jan 2024, no you can not apply a skin to the Holy Fire.

**Can we re-roll the challenges?**

No.

**What happens if I don't complete 4 out of 5 challenges each week?**

You are out of luck and won't be able to unlock the end reward. Sorry.

**Can I complete these challenges on a custom server?**

No.

**Can I complete these challenges on a private server, by myself, if I create a public team?**

Yes.

**Can I complete these challenges in one day?** 

Yes. All the challenges for the week will be released on the first day, allowing you a week to complete them.

__Where to find a Flamer and the Flamer plan__

**Flamer**

**Fixed spawn locations**

Quarry X3

From the fast travel point, follow the road North until you get to the buildings on the other side of the lake. Look for the yellow pump on the edge of the water. The Flamer spawns between the pump and the semi-circle shed.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_9993183a175f42468d998e9fe31c91de~mv2.jpg)

**The Neapolitan Casino**

In the caged room that you go to, to enter Quentino's Night Club, on the wooden crate, in the corner.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_f760dea0d0fc4c5c826d6c5c8c2d7b63~mv2.jpg)

In the manager's office, where one of the accounting terminals can spawn. In the corner, on the metal trolley.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_a9bc5ed3a8824f2fb4478d6ea2d97cfe~mv2.jpg)

Players can craft Flamers and drop them for other players.

**Plan: Flamer**

**Can be purchased from**

- Whitesprings Mall - Free States vendor
- Whitesprings Mall - Local Goods Vendor (next to Helena)
- Berkeley Springs Train Station - Wallace
- Watoga Train Station Vendor
- Player Vendors

**Drops from Treasure Maps**

- Savage Divide - 0.059%
- Ash Heap - 0.113%
- The Mire - 0.113%
- Cranberry Bog - 0.113%

**Can drop from creatures**

- Behemoth
- Deathclaw
- Fog Crawler
- Grafton Monster
- Hermit Crab
- Honey Beast
- Mega Sloth
- Mothman
- Scorchbeast
- Sheepsquatch
- Crowned Enemies

__Daily Challenges and Rewards__

__Week 1__

**Kill 10 Gulper's while on a team using the Hot Rod Pink Flamer.**

Reward

250 Score

**Kill 15 Mirelurk Hunters, Mirelurk Kings, Mirelurk Queens, Mirelurks, and/or Mirelurk Hatchlings while on a team using the Hot Rod Pink Flamer.**

Reward

3x Legendary Modules

**Kill 30 Feral and/or Glowing Ghouls while on a team using the Hot Rod Pink Flamer.**

Reward

3x Repair Kits

**Kill 10 Overgrown Elders, Overgrown Pollinator's and/or Overgrown Thorn's while on a team using the Hot Rod Pink Flamer.**

The Most Sensational Game is the better expo for this challenge.

Reward

3x Lunchboxes

**Kill 10 Fanatics while on a team using the Hot Rod Pink Flamer.**

Union Dues is the better expo for this challenge.

Reward

3x Perk Card Packs

__Week 2__

**Kill 30 Humans (Blood Eagles, Cultists, and other Humanoid enemies) while on a team using the Hot Rod Pink Flamer.**

Reward

3x Lunchboxes

**Kill 10 Glowing Enemies while on a team using the Hot Rod Pink Flamer.**

Nuked creatures count. If you get stuck then the Glowing Radroachs in the bunkers in The Mire will work for this challenge.

Reward

250 Score

**Kill 1 Lesser Devil using the Hot Rod Pink Flamer.**

Tax Evasion expo only.

From the Veribird, turn and face South. Jump off the edge of the platform to the ground level.

Face South and follow the road to the end. Stop when you get to the bus and jump on top of it. Face South and you should see a set of stairs in front of you.

Walk over and follow the stairs to the top. At the top of the stairs, face East and use the Nuka Cola sign to get over to the next platform. Face South and walk behind the circular structure and the Lesser Devils will spawn.

Reward

3x Repair Kits

**Kill 30 Scorched while on a team using the Hot Rod Pink Flamer.**

Reward

3x Legendary Modules

**Kill 10 Trogs while on a team using the Hot Rod Pink Flamer.**

From Ashes to Fire is the better expo for this challenge.

Reward

3x Perk Card Packs

Complete 4 out of 5 challenges

Reinhart's Jumpsuit
